mapper.select: SELECT id, goal_id, project_id, title, description, priority, status, due_date, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (due_date = #{date} OR due_date IS NULL) ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task(user_id, goal_id, project_id, title, description, priority, status, due_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{task.goalId}, #{task.projectId}, #{task.title}, #{task.description}, #{task.priority}, COALESCE(#{task.status}, 'TODO'), #{task.dueDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
